title: EIP-7594: PeerDAS - Peer Data Availability Sampling

sub_graphs.name: 1D Erasure Coding Extension
sub_graphs.description: Extends EIP-4844 blobs using one-dimensional erasure coding. Each row consists of blob data combined with its erasure code, subdivided into cells (smallest authenticatable units via KZG commitments). Each column maps to a specific gossip subnet.

invariants.text: A node can reconstruct the entire data matrix if it acquires at least 50% of all columns.
Each cell MUST be authenticatable with its respective blob's KZG commitment.
A maximum of 6 blobs per transaction MUST be enforced at submission time, when received from the network, and during block production and processing.

pre_conditions.text: EIP-4844 blob transactions must already be supported by the network.

post_conditions.text: All blob data is available and reconstructible from at least 50% of columns.

state_variables.name: CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB
state_variables.description: Number of cells for an extended blob, defined in consensus specs.

state_variables.name: NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS
state_variables.description: Total number of samples possible (parameter m in security analysis).

state_variables.name: SAMPLES_PER_SLOT
state_variables.description: Minimum number of samples a node must download per slot (parameter k in security analysis).

sub_graphs.name: Column-Based Custody and Sampling
sub_graphs.description: Each node maintains a deterministic set of column subnets as a function of their node ID. Nodes find and maintain a diverse peer set and sample columns from peers to perform DAS every slot.

invariants.text: Each node's custody set is deterministic as a function of their node ID.
Validators have an additional custody requirement that scales with the validator count.

post_conditions.text: Nodes can request missing columns (below 50% threshold) from peer nodes.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Wrapper Modification (Networking)
sub_graphs.description: Modifies the EIP-4844 transaction pool wrapper for blob transactions to include cell KZG proofs and a wrapper version, replacing the old proofs field.

invariants.text: cell_proofs MUST contain exactly CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB * len(blobs) cell proofs.
KZG commitments MUST hash to the versioned hashes: kzg_to_versioned_hash(commitments[i]) == tx_payload_body.blob_versioned_hashes[i].
There MUST be an equal number of tx_payload_body.blob_versioned_hashes, blobs, and commitments.
KZG commitments MUST match the corresponding blobs and cell_proofs (verified via compute_cells and verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch).

pre_conditions.text: Blob transaction senders MUST compute cell proofs themselves and include them in the wrapper.

post_conditions.text: The node MUST validate tx_payload_body and verify the wrapped data against it.

state_variables.name: wrapper_version
state_variables.description: One byte indicating wrapper version. Currently set to 1.

functions.description: Outputs all cells of a blob including extension cells.
Batch verifies all cell KZG proofs against their commitments.
Converts a KZG commitment to a versioned hash.

data_structures.name: PooledTransactions wrapper
data_structures.description: Modified transaction wrapper for gossip responses including cell proofs.

sub_graphs.name: Withholding Attack Security Model
sub_graphs.description: Formalizes the security of PeerDAS against data withholding attacks using a probabilistic bound. The probability of convincing a fraction epsilon of nodes that data is available when withheld decreases rapidly with network size.

invariants.text: For mainnet parameters (10,000 nodes), the probability of a successful withholding attack drops to negligible (< 10^-20) when targeting more than 2% of nodes.

title: EIP-7823: Set Upper Bounds for MODEXP

sub_graphs.name: MODEXP Input Length Bound
sub_graphs.description: Introduces an upper bound on MODEXP precompile inputs. Each of the three length inputs (length_of_BASE, length_of_EXPONENT, length_of_MODULUS) MUST be <= 8192 bits (1024 bytes).

invariants.text: Each of length_of_BASE, length_of_EXPONENT, and length_of_MODULUS MUST be less than or equal to 8192 bits (1024 bytes).
If any input length exceeds the limit, the precompile execution MUST stop, return an error, and consume all gas.

pre_conditions.text: MODEXP precompile at address 0x05 accepts input in format: <length_of_BASE> <length_of_EXPONENT> <length_of_MODULUS> <BASE> <EXPONENT> <MODULUS> (per EIP-198).

post_conditions.text: Successful MODEXP execution only occurs when all input lengths are within the 1024-byte bound.
Out-of-bound inputs result in error with full gas consumption.

state_variables.name: MODEXP_INPUT_LIMIT
state_variables.description: Maximum input field size: 8192 bits (1024 bytes).

functions.description: Precompile at 0x05 now with upper bound enforcement on all three input lengths.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Gas Limit Enforcement
sub_graphs.description: Introduces a protocol-level cap on maximum gas per transaction to 16,777,216 (2^24). This cap applies regardless of block gas limit and is enforced at txpool validation and block validation.

invariants.text: No single transaction may specify a gasLimit exceeding 16,777,216 (2^24) gas.
The transaction gas cap is independent of the block gas limit.

post_conditions.text: Transactions with gasLimit > 16,777,216 are invalidated and not included in the txpool.
Blocks containing a transaction with gasLimit > 16,777,216 are deemed invalid and rejected.

state_transitions.description: Txpool validation: if sender's gasLimit > 16,777,216, transaction is invalidated (MAX_GAS_LIMIT_EXCEEDED error).
Block validation: any block with a transaction having gasLimit > 16,777,216 is rejected as invalid.

sub_graphs.name: ModExp Gas Pricing Algorithm Update
sub_graphs.description: Modifies the EIP-2565 ModExp precompile pricing: increases minimum gas from 200 to 500, triples general cost (removes /3 divisor), and doubles cost for exponents >32 bytes (multiplier 8->16). Introduces minimum multiplication_complexity of 16 and doubles complexity for base/modulus >32 bytes.

invariants.text: Minimum gas cost for MODEXP is 500 (increased from 200).
General cost is multiplication_complexity * iteration_count (no division by 3).
Minimum multiplication_complexity is 16 (for base/modulus <= 32 bytes).
For base/modulus > 32 bytes, multiplication_complexity = 2 * words^2.
For exponents > 32 bytes, iteration_count multiplier is 16 (increased from 8).

pre_conditions.text: Precompile at address 0x05 must be called with valid MODEXP inputs per EIP-198.

post_conditions.text: Gas charged according to new formula: max(500, floor(multiplication_complexity * iteration_count)).

functions.description: Returns min 16 for <=32 bytes, or 2*words^2 for >32 bytes, where words=ceil(max_length/8).
Returns iteration count with 16x multiplier for exponent_length > 32 bytes (was 8x). Minimum return value is 1.

sub_graphs.name: BPO Hardfork Definition and Configuration
sub_graphs.description: Defines BPO (Blob Parameter Only) hardforks as protocol upgrades that modify only blob-related parameters (target, max, baseFeeUpdateFraction) through configuration without requiring client code changes.

invariants.text: BPO hardforks MUST only modify blob-related parameters: target, max, baseFeeUpdateFraction.
No client-side code changes are required for BPO forks.
When a regular hardfork changes blob parameters, it MUST do so by adding an entry to the blob schedule configuration.
Execution and consensus clients MUST share consistent BPO fork schedules.
The EL blobSchedule slot MUST align with the start of the epoch specified in CL configuration.
The EL max field MUST equal the CL MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK value.

pre_conditions.text: EIP-7840 blobSchedule configuration must be supported.

post_conditions.text: New blob parameters take effect immediately at the specified activation time.

state_variables.name: blobSchedule.target
state_variables.description: Expected number of blobs per block.

state_variables.name: blobSchedule.max
state_variables.description: Maximum number of blobs per block.

state_variables.name: blobSchedule.baseFeeUpdateFraction
state_variables.description: Determines how blob gas pricing adjusts per block.

data_structures.name: BlobSchedule
data_structures.definition: class BlobSchedule: target: U64, max: U64, base_fee_update_fraction: Uint
data_structures.description: Configuration object holding blob parameters for a fork.

sub_graphs.name: Modified Blob Base Fee Computation
sub_graphs.description: Modifies calc_excess_blob_gas and get_base_fee_per_blob_gas to explicitly use the blob schedule, removing the static TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK.

invariants.text: TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK is removed; replaced by GAS_PER_BLOB * blob_schedule.target.
Functions use the current block's blob schedule.

functions.description: Calculates excess blob gas using dynamic blob schedule instead of static constant.
Calculates base fee per blob gas using dynamic blob schedule's baseFeeUpdateFraction.

sub_graphs.name: Modified Fork Digest for P2P Networking
sub_graphs.description: Updates compute_fork_digest to account for BPO forks by bitmasking blob parameters (max_blobs_per_block) into the fork digest, enabling automatic topic rotation at BPO forks.

invariants.text: All gossip topics automatically rotate at a BPO fork due to changes in ForkDigestValue.
max_blobs_per_block MUST be in range [0, 0xFFFFFFFF] for safe bitmasking.

functions.description: Returns 4-byte fork digest with blob parameters bitmasked in, for p2p domain separation.

data_structures.name: BlobScheduleEntry
data_structures.description: CL configuration entry for blob schedule.

sub_graphs.name: Proposer Lookahead State Extension
sub_graphs.description: Extends BeaconState with a proposer_lookahead field: a vector of validator indices covering MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1 epochs starting from the current epoch. Pre-calculated at epoch boundary.

invariants.text: proposer_lookahead MUST be a Vector[ValidatorIndex, (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1) * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH].
proposer_lookahead[0] is the validator index for the first proposer in the current epoch.
The lookahead for epoch N uses RANDAO from epoch N - MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD - 1 and effective balances from epoch N - MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD.
It is no longer possible for validators to grind effective balances to manipulate the proposer schedule of the next epoch.

pre_conditions.text: The first block after fork must calculate all lookaheads for epochs up to MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD ahead.

post_conditions.text: Next-epoch proposer schedule is fully deterministic and accessible via beacon root + Merkle proof.

functions.description: Returns proposer index from pre-calculated lookahead: state.proposer_lookahead[state.slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH].
At epoch boundary: shifts out current epoch's lookahead, appends new epoch's proposer indices.

functions.signature: get_beacon_proposer_indices(state: BeaconState, epoch: Epoch) -> Vector[ValidatorIndex, SLOTS_PER_EPOCH]
functions.description: Returns proposer indices for the given epoch using active validators and seed.

functions.signature: compute_proposer_indices(state, epoch, seed, indices) -> Vector[ValidatorIndex, SLOTS_PER_EPOCH]
functions.description: Computes proposer indices for each slot in the given epoch from seed.

data_structures.name: BeaconState (extended)
data_structures.description: Extended beacon state with deterministic proposer lookahead vector.

state_transitions.description: At each epoch boundary: shift proposer_lookahead left by SLOTS_PER_EPOCH positions, fill last epoch with newly computed proposer indices for epoch (current + MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1).

title: EIP-7918: Blob Base Fee Bounded by Execution Cost

sub_graphs.name: Blob Reserve Price Mechanism
sub_graphs.description: Imposes a reserve price on blobs by modifying calc_excess_blob_gas(). When BLOB_BASE_COST * base_fee_per_gas > GAS_PER_BLOB * base_fee_per_blob_gas, excess_blob_gas increases without subtracting target_blob_gas, preventing the blob fee from dropping below the execution cost floor.

invariants.text: BLOB_BASE_COST = 2^13 (8192).
The reserve blob base fee is BLOB_BASE_COST * base_fee_per_gas / GAS_PER_BLOB.
The ratio between reserve price and execution base fee is fixed at BLOB_BASE_COST / GAS_PER_BLOB = 1/16.
The blob fee's share of total price is always at least BLOB_BASE_COST / (BLOB_BASE_COST + execution_cost).
The per-block maximum increase in excess_blob_gas remains unchanged.

pre_conditions.text: EIP-4844 blob fee market must be active.
EIP-7840 blobSchedule for target, max, baseFeeUpdateFraction must be available.

post_conditions.text: Blob consumers always pay at least a fraction (1/16) of the execution base fee for blob compute.
The blob fee update mechanism can properly converge to equilibrium instead of falling to 1 wei.

state_variables.name: BLOB_BASE_COST
state_variables.description: Constant = 2^13 (8192). Defines the execution gas equivalent reserve price per blob.

functions.description: Modified to include if-clause: when reserve price exceeds blob price, uses blob_gas_used * (max - target) // max instead of subtracting target_blob_gas. Uses current block's blobSchedule.

title: EIP-7934: RLP Execution Block Size Limit

sub_graphs.name: RLP Block Size Validation
sub_graphs.description: Introduces a protocol-level cap on maximum RLP-encoded execution block size to 10 MiB (MAX_BLOCK_SIZE), with a 2 MiB safety margin for beacon blocks, yielding MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE of ~8 MiB.

invariants.text: MAX_BLOCK_SIZE = 10,485,760 bytes (10 MiB).
SAFETY_MARGIN = 2,097,152 bytes (2 MiB).
MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE = MAX_BLOCK_SIZE - SAFETY_MARGIN = 8,388,608 bytes (~8 MiB).
Any RLP-encoded block exceeding MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE MUST be considered invalid.
This limit applies independently of gas-related metrics.

post_conditions.text: Validators must ensure produced blocks do not exceed MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE.
Nodes must reject blocks whose RLP-encoded size exceeds MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE.

state_variables.name: MAX_BLOCK_SIZE
state_variables.description: 10,485,760 bytes (10 MiB) - overall block size constraint including CL overhead.

state_variables.name: SAFETY_MARGIN
state_variables.description: 2,097,152 bytes (2 MiB) - reserved for beacon block overhead.

state_variables.name: MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE
state_variables.description: 8,388,608 bytes (~8 MiB) - effective limit for RLP-encoded execution blocks.

functions.description: Returns True if len(rlp.encode(block)) > MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE, indicating the block is invalid.

title: EIP-7935: Set Default Gas Limit to 60M

sub_graphs.name: Default Gas Limit Configuration Update
sub_graphs.description: Recommends EL clients update their default gas limit configuration to 60M for Fusaka, up from the current 36M mainnet gas limit. This is a configuration-only change, not a protocol enforcement.

invariants.text: Recommended default gas limit is 60,000,000 (60M) for Fusaka.
This is a client configuration change, not a protocol-enforced limit.

pre_conditions.text: EIP-7825 transaction gas limit cap (2^24) should be coordinated with this change.

post_conditions.text: EL client defaults generate configurations with 60M gas limit.

sub_graphs.name: CLZ Opcode Definition
sub_graphs.description: Introduces CLZ opcode (0x1e) that pops x from the stack and pushes the number of leading zero bits in x (256 if x=0). Gas cost is 5.

invariants.text: CLZ opcode is assigned bytecode 0x1e.
CLZ(x) for x > 0 returns the number of zero bits preceding the most significant one bit in the 256-bit representation.
Gas cost of CLZ is 5 (matching MUL).

pre_conditions.text: Stack must have at least 1 element (x).

post_conditions.text: Stack has x popped and result (0-256) pushed.

functions.description: Pops x, pushes count of leading zero bits. Returns 256 if x=0. Gas cost: 5.
